name: probe-parent-deny
description: ONE-OFF PROBE AGENT (Task 0 item 7-②). Parent that expresses 'I do not write' via a permissions DENY on fs_write **. Tests whether that deny propagates to a spawned sub-agent by deny-wins intersection and disables the sub-agent's writes. Not a team agent config.
prompt: You are a probe harness parent. Delegate the write probe to the probe-write-scoped sub-agent and report verbatim whether the sub-agent could write /tmp/kiro-probe/allowed/d.txt, including any rule text in the failure. Do not attempt the write yourself.
